description: This file defines the data structures and function prototypes for parsing and managing watchdog service configurations, including the serviceDefinition struct and related functions.

methods.name: loadServiceConfig
methods.description: Parses the watchdog configuration file and returns a linked list of serviceDefinition objects.

methods.name: saveMisbehavingService
methods.description: Saves a problematic service name to prevent repeated reboot cycles.

methods.name: readMisbehavingService
methods.description: Reads and deletes the saved problematic service name, returning it to the caller.

methods.name: destroyServiceDefinition
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a serviceDefinition object.
